============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    920 ns | 1,086,721 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1282 ns | 780,291 | 350 | 1.39x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2311 ns | 432,651 | 350 | 2.51x slower |
| google-protobuf |   4763 ns | 209,930 | 350 | 5.18x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3166 ns | 315,890 | 622 | 3.44x slower |
| JSON |   1819 ns | 549,711 | 791 | 1.98x slower |
